div.head: Mirce Inscr.
div.ab: Concerning the law of the Mercians
div.note: Liebermann prints D (Cambridge, Corpus Christi College 201, p. 102, after Norðleod, c. 1060; by its author or someone using or influenced by him), O (Cambridge, Corpus Christi College 190, p. 418, another hand c. 1075, after the Confessional and Penitential of Egbert) and H (Textus Roffensis f. 39v, after Að, c. 1120, without heading, on a new line), with Ld, the Quadripartitus and the Instituta Cnuti III 42–43.4. K is H, which has no heading, so K is empty here; D is also given here. D's heading is in red; the Quadripartitus heading is not original. Liebermann dates Mirce c. 920–c. 970. Clause number standardised from ‘Mirce Inscr.’.
